reuse.why: Extracts the month-wide category query that four actions copied into getMonthWideCategories and uses it for the new action and the existing ones, plus existing getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages and the undoable mutator registration.

duplication.why: Removes four copies of the selection SQL; only the per-action income guard and expense sign flip are repeated, matching set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: Helper and action live in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions; the handler is registered in app.ts with the other budget methods.

scope.why: Consolidating the existing actions' query is a small, related refactor beyond the strict request, plus a release note per repo convention.

maintainability.why: The rule for which categories month-wide actions touch now lives in one function used by every bulk action, so the new action cannot drift from it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared NO_SAVED_TEMPLATES rule through the new getMonthWideCategories helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The income-skip and sign-flip lines are an open copy of set3MonthAvg's, not disguised.
